chapter: Hutto 1978-79: family, favorites and record lists
title: Paul Specht band as the most rewarding job
summary: He names the Specht band as his favorite, even over Goldkette, because Specht gave him the most liberty at the Alamac Hotel.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Of all the bands you played with, which was the most fun or the most rewarding?
I think the Paul Specht band.
Even more than the Goldkette band?
Yes because he gave me more liberty than anybody else.
I guess it lasted a few years.
And we played at the Alamac Hotel.
